source_title: Pokemon GO Bringing Back Eternatus and Almost Every Dynamax Pokemon - GameRant
source_excerpt:
Pokemon GO has revealed the upcoming Dynamax Trails event, which will feature the return of Eternatus, alongside almost every previously released Dynamax Pokemon. Max Battles have been a part of Pokemon GO over the last few years, and are inspired by the Dynamax and Gigantamax mechanic that debuted in Pokemon Sword and Shield . In those Nintendo Switch games, Eternatus was the reason that Pokemon in the Galar region were able to Dynamax or Gigantamax.
Eternatus has been one of the rarer Pokemon available in Pokemon GO , and its return should be a big deal for players that missed out on previous opportunities. In addition to playing a key role in the storyline for Pokemon Sword and Shield , Eternatus was also a big threat in the anime, offering a significant challenge for Ash, Leon, and Goh.
Beginning on Monday, November 16 at 10 AM local time , the Dynamax Trails event in Pokemon GO will put a major focus on Max Battles. Throughout the week, players can expect to see more active Power Spots than usual, and almost every Dynamax Pokemon introduced in Pokemon GO will have a chance of making an appearance. This will not include Legendary or Mythical Pokemon, however. Players will also have a chance of getting Pokemon with a Special Background when participating in Max Battles. Pokemon GO teased the return of Eternatus , and developer Scopely Explore has now confirmed the Legendary will return through the GO Pass: Dynamax Trails. Eternamax Eternatus will also take over most Power Spots on Saturday, November 21 from 11 AM to 2 PM local time.
Pokemon GO already revealed the November GO Pass , but a special progression track will debut during the event. The GO Pass: Dynamax Trails will be offered at the start of the event for everyone, but there will be an option to get it a little earlier for some players. Those who claim the Tier 1 rewards from the GO Pass: Into the Wild will receive access to GO Pass: Dynamax Trails on Saturday, November 14 at 10 AM local time. Those players will also be automatically upgraded to the GO Pass Deluxe, which will otherwise cost $4.99 in the game's shop. The Eternatus encounter in the GO Pass will only be offered to those that haven't caught the Pokemon yet; those who already have an Eternatus in Pokemon GO will receive 100 Candy, instead. Eternatus Candy and Candy XL are some of the rewards that will be offered in the GO Pass: Dynamax Trails, alongside Stardust, Rare Candy, and more.

During the event, almost all Pokemon that have appeared in Dynamax Max Battles will also appear in the wild. Players will be rewarded with Max Particles after catching some of them, and the Max Particle collection limit will be increased to 2,400. Like the Pokemon appearing in Power Spots, Pokemon appearing in the wild will exclude Legendary and Mythical Pokemon that have had Dynamax forms in the game. Players will not receive Max Particles on Catches when using the Go Plus+, or when using Pokemon GO 's in-game Explorer Gadget .
The Dynamax Trails event will run through Monday, November 23 at 8 PM local time. This will mark one of the final events in Pokemon GO 's Twilight Trails season , which is scheduled to come to an end on December 1. Scopely Explore has not revealed any information about the next season's theme, or which Pokemon will debut. Since the next season will likely run through the end of February, players could expect a focus on the winter, and possibly Ice-type Pokemon.
